name: chunk-repeat-identical-accepted
description: a continuation chunk MAY repeat toolCallName and parentMessageId as long as the values agree with the opener
kill: make chunk expansion reject any repeated field on a continuation rather than only a conflicting one

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. The TEXT_MESSAGE_* triad still assembles; only the repeated TOOL_CALL_CHUNK pair is lost, so the message arrives without its tool call.
